name: patient_has_suspicion_of_acute_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not suspected to have acute appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently suspected to have acute appendicitis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_flank_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has flank pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of flank pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of flank pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of flank pain.

name: patient_has_undergone_appendectomy_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy at any time in the past (i.e., a previous appendectomy).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone an appendectomy at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently known not to be pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_finding_of_unstable_vital_signs_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has unstable vital signs.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has unstable vital signs.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have unstable vital signs.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has unstable vital signs.

name: patient_has_finding_of_peritonitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has peritonitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of peritonitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of peritonitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has peritonitis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_peritonitis_now@@frank
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current peritonitis is frank.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current peritonitis is frank (overt, severe, or clinically obvious).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current peritonitis is not frank (i.e., not overt, severe, or clinically obvious).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current peritonitis is frank.

name: patient_has_undergone_ultrasonography_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone ultrasonography at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone ultrasonography at any time in the past, regardless of timing relative to other events.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone ultrasonography at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone ultrasonography in the past.

name: patient_has_undergone_ultrasonography_inthehistory@@performed_before_emergency_physician_examination
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's ultrasonography was performed before the emergency physician's examination.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone ultrasonography at any time in the past and the procedure was performed before the emergency physician's examination.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has ever undergone ultrasonography in the past but it was not performed before the emergency physician's examination.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the ultrasonography was performed before the emergency physician's examination.
